8f89ca70-328a-4f41-9f14-e5a8c669ab20.title: Easy Apply — paced worker with known screening answers
8f89ca70-328a-4f41-9f14-e5a8c669ab20.description: Generic LinkedIn Easy Apply walker with human pacing. Resolves the question text from the DOM (works on both the standard modal and 12-page Lever/Workday style forms), fills only the confirmed screening answers, treats Bedrock/Vertex/Azure-OpenAI/Kafka-ownership claims as blockers and returns the exact question instead of guessing.
